notes.title: In Stone Live Streaming - Next Fest October 2023
notes.content: We're streaming demo for Next Fest 2023 October!

notes.title: Demo bug fixed now!
notes.content:
Hello!

The bug that demo files were not installed is fixed now.
This version of demo supports English and Korean.
Previous Japanese translations will be reviewed and supported in the released version!

We are truly sorry for the inconvenience.
And Thank you for reporting the bug.
I hope you enjoy the rest of the Next Fest!
